text.en:
Any provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding, all registrable deeds of conveyance
and/or mortgage and other documents executed by the National Housing Authority pursuant to Proclamation
No. 843 in favor of its intended project beneficiaries shall be registered in the Office of the Register of Deeds
of Caloocan City without need of presenting the owner’s duplicate of the certificate of title covering the area
thus conveyed or encumbered. In all cases of transfers of ownership to project beneficiaries of the Authority,
the Register of Deeds of Caloocan City is authorized to issue the corresponding new transfer certificates of
title on the basis of the original copies of Transfer of Certificates of Title Nos. 34591 thru 34637 which are in
the custody of the Registry of Deeds of Rizal and/or the Register of Deeds of Caloocan City.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 21, 1983
